title: REQ · AdminApp renders LifecycleStepper for the current Round
summary: AdminApp loads the Round's execution and shows the stepper at the derived stage
description: Context: AdminApp loads the admin Round and contributions after the token is entered. Desired behavior: it also lists executions, picks the one for the Round, and renders LifecycleStepper with deriveStage(round.status, execution?.status). Expected result: the stepper is visible with the right current step; a non-401 failure of the executions call leaves the stepper on the Round status. Why: live lifecycle view for the admin.
acceptance_criteria: Given token secret and an OPEN Round, when AdminApp loads, then list 'Round lifecycle' has exactly one aria-current step reading OPEN.
Given a CLOSED Round and a RUNNING execution for that Round, when AdminApp loads, then the current step reads DEVELOPING.
Given the executions endpoint returns 404, when AdminApp loads, then the stepper still shows the Round status stage and no error alert appears.
Given the executions endpoint returns 401, when AdminApp loads, then the token gate shows Invalid token.

preserve: Token gate, Open/Close round, contributions list, existing admin tests

technical_constraints: Use listExecutions and findExecutionForRound from api/client.ts
